market_summary: London session shows strong US dollar expansion pushing EURUSD and GBPUSD lower below their respective Value Areas with high-volume momentum. US100 maintains a clear bullish trend above VWAP testing session highs, while XAUUSD and BTCUSD consolidate near local resistance requiring further confirmation before directional commitment.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 4039.33, VAH 4059.52) and trading above POC 4044.58. CVD is NEUTRAL (-0.69) with flat slope. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is holding just above VWAP 4048.72 and EMA50 4051.07. ATR bands are mid-channel near baseline EMA20 4052.72. Volume is low with no recent RVOL spikes (rvol 0.738). Rejection around local S/R 4052.38 keeps structure neutral within the range. Action: HOLD.

Price is below VAL 1.11445 and POC 1.11658, indicating strong bearish value acceptance. CVD is BEARISH (-3,710.26), agreeing with price movement. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is below VWAP 1.11532 and EMA50 1.1156, hugging the lower ATR band 1.11356 in a persistent downward trend. Recent move broke below Prev Low 1.11456 with volume support (multiple RVOL spikes). Setup favors continuation to Session Low 1.11314. Action: SELL.
signals.level_event: breakout below VAL and Prev Low 1.11456

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL 1.33232 and well below POC 1.33468. CVD is NEUTRAL (-1,421.0) showing mild sell pressure. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is below VWAP 1.33343 and EMA50 1.33381, pressing right near the lower ATR band 1.33146. Volume has recent yellow spikes confirming the downward drive, testing Session Low 1.33141 support. Action: SELL.

Price is inside VA (VAL 28017.71, VAH 28261.60) near VAH and well above POC 28114.25. CVD is BULLISH (+8.28), agreeing with the strong upward channel. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is well above VWAP 28078.45 and EMA50 28066.38, consolidating near upper ATR band 28259.0. Dukascopy tick volume rarely prints RVOL > 2, but market structure shows high-tf uptrend. Currently testing Session High 28261.60 resistance. Action: BUY.

Price is trading above VAH 73808.59 and POC 73660.40. However, CVD is BEARISH (-0.04) presenting a slight divergence. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is above VWAP 73644.23 and EMA50 73694.06, but signal candle wicked off Session High 74085.20 near upper ATR band 74176.93. RVOL is average (1.089) with no yellow spikes. Rejection at high without delta confluence suggests potential consolidation or pullback toward EMA20/VWAP. Action: HOLD.
